title.zh: Blockstream Refuses Ransom for Return of $47M in Bitcoin from Liquid Hack: 'It Is Theft'
title.en: Blockstream Refuses Ransom for Return of $47M in Bitcoin from Liquid Hack: 'It Is Theft'

current_state.zh: Blockstream has refused to pay a ransom for the return of approximately 598.5 BTC (about $47 million) still missing after the Liquid Network exploit, after hackers returned roughly 3,400 BTC, and says it will work with law enforcement and forensic specialists to trace the remaining funds.
current_state.en: Blockstream has refused to pay a ransom for the return of approximately 598.5 BTC (about $47 million) still missing after the Liquid Network exploit, after hackers returned roughly 3,400 BTC, and says it will work with law enforcement and forensic specialists to trace the remaining funds.
